anterior-eye-oct.title: Clinical utility of anterior segment swept-source optical coherence tomography in glaucoma
anterior-eye-oct.source: Original clinical article archived in PubMed Central
anterior-eye-oct.creator: Original article authors; individual image photographer not separately established in this review
anterior-eye-oct.matches: Actual human anterior-segment OCT: Figure 2 shows corneal boundary, chamber and iris/angle; Figure 7 shows cornea, chamber, iris and lens region with dimensional overlays.
anterior-eye-oct.viewLimitations: Use Figures 2 and 7, not Figure 1 equipment photo. Other figures include named glaucoma/surgical pathology. OCT does not establish all zonular fibres or directly photograph aqueous flow.
anterior-eye-oct.reproductionRights: Original article linked, not copied; no reproduction licence asserted or exercised.
anterior-eye-oct.visualEvidence: Browser inspected actual grayscale clinical OCT panels; 7cavf1 Figure 2, 115sgo Figure 7, ro7nf0 measurement overlays. Main agent directly viewed 115sgo. Article explicitly discusses imaging components of the human eye; this is real diagnostic scan data, not an anatomy outline.

sciatic-human.title: Anatomical variation in bifurcation and trifurcations of sciatic nerve and its clinical implications
sciatic-human.source: Original cadaveric study archived in PubMed Central
sciatic-human.creator: Original article authors; see article byline
sciatic-human.matches: Actual human cadaver photographs show right sciatic trunk/tibial/common peroneal division and posterior gluteal/thigh/popliteal relationships.
sciatic-human.viewLimitations: These photographs document anatomical VARIANTS, not a normal complete lower-limb nerve map. Figure 1 is right high bifurcation; Figure 3 right popliteal trifurcation. Femoral nerve is not shown. Small static fields do not resolve every fine branch.
sciatic-human.reproductionRights: Original study page linked; no source photograph reproduced.
sciatic-human.visualEvidence: Study Methods explicitly identify 28 formalin-fixed human cadavers. Browser inspected all seven actual photographs: dii5ze Figure 1 right gluteal/thigh, cikozi Figure 3 right popliteal, g6fygs/517unn/jamu6n left-sided variants. Main agent directly viewed dii5ze and its exact caption.

uterine-myometrium.viewLimitations: Open human uterus 0041_I and zoom to 20X in the muscle-rich upper/intermediate wall. Initial overview includes endometrial glands; do not mistake those for muscle. No calibrated pixel scale asserted.

human-retina.title: Improved protocol for histological and histopathological preparation of large eyes

human-retina.visualEvidence: Browser directly inspected rendered Figure 6, 709x492, screenshot mpv8z9. Caption explicitly distinguishes rabbit a-c from human donor d-e. No human anterior-chamber histology was established from the unspecified/unloaded preparation photos.
